answer: Escrow and a public referral graph block bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 100 POA for 20 epochs and names a sponsor; no velvet carpet waives the bond. The open graph exposes clusters sharing one sponsor, layered like shale, and peers may dispute suspects. Proven forgery burns the escrow and slashes the sponsor 30 POA, so a comet account flashing in still leaves its bond behind. Forging 1,000 identities costs 130,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
